response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) as tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), totals AS (SELECT SUM(tally) as total_tally, COUNT(*) as num_statuses FROM status_counts), with_calculations AS (SELECT sc.archstat, sc.tally, CAST(sc.tally AS FLOAT) / CAST(t.total_tally AS FLOAT) as share, CAST(1 AS FLOAT) / CAST(t.num_statuses AS FLOAT) as avg_share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT archstat, tally, share, (share - avg_share) as above_average FROM with_calculations WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY archstat
